subject.title: [BUG] OpenAI Codex errors leak into user chat

question: Should this issue be fixed as parser support only, or should OpenClaw also suppress or no-reply unconfigured Codex/provider failures at the routing boundary?
rationale: The parser gap is source-reproducible, but silently discarding or converting unconfigured-provider failures changes user-visible diagnostics and provider-routing policy.

options.title: Parser plus routing policy
options.body: Add top-level `detail` parsing and define tested generic versus no-reply behavior for unconfigured provider failures across user-facing delivery paths.

options.title: Parser-only repair
options.body: Land the narrow `detail` parser/test fix now and track silent unconfigured-provider suppression as a separate policy issue.

options.title: Document existing fallback policy
options.body: Keep provider failures user-visible as generic errors and document that unconfigured-provider silent discard is not currently supported.

recommendation.title: Parser plus routing policy
recommendation.body: Add top-level `detail` parsing and define tested generic versus no-reply behavior for unconfigured provider failures across user-facing delivery paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This account merged the adjacent raw provider-error suppression boundary and is the strongest available routing owner for the remaining policy choice.
